label: NOTE: what this set is for, and the five claims it cannot reach
why: V92ConvolutionEncoder's four processing members, its two static tables and t_v92convmapper.cpp's five new fixtures were written by one hand at one sitting from one reading of 0x54740-0x55030 and .data 0x6ac0/0x6bc0, so a green run says the two agree and not that either is right. Every entry below is a claim the disassembly makes: the residue rotation and its positive fixup, which label indexes which table, the state and input bit weights of all three trellis arms, which array each store lands in, and that process carries the state forward. WHAT NO ENTRY HERE CAN REACH, and why not. (1) PERMUTING THE for LOOPS OF ANY ARM. For each fixed input the arm's state->nextState map is a bijection, so every reachable slot is written exactly once and a different visiting order produces a byte-identical object. A loop-swap mutation would read NOT CAUGHT, and it is not `equivalent` either -- the instruction text differs -- so it is recorded here rather than entered above. The loop order is claimed from the object's strength-reduced stack accumulators alone. (2) MOVING `state = 0` ABOVE the makeStateTtransitionTable() call in reset. The builder never reads +0x04, so the two orders are indistinguishable from outside; only the object's instruction order says the store comes after the call. The other half of that statement order IS tested -- `the mode is stored after the tables are built` below. (3) THE ORDER OF THE TWO STATIC DEFINITIONS. cosetMapping4D precedes subsetLabelTable because .data puts 0x6ac0 before 0x6bc0; nothing executable can see it. (4) THE DEFAULT ARM OF process's switch, deviation D262: it stores and returns two registers nothing wrote, so driving it would compare two different pieces of stack. No mutation here changes behaviour only on that arm, and none should. (5) THE SIGN OF THE ROTATION. `((x - 2) % 4 + 4) % 4` is the same function as `((x + 2) % 4 + 4) % 4` -- two quadrants one way and two the other are the same rotation modulo four -- and that mutation was tried here and read NOT CAUGHT, correctly. It is not entered above because it is not `equivalent` in this file's sense either: the instruction text differs (`lea 0x2(%ecx)` against `lea -0x2(%ecx)`, and different fixup constants on both `js` arms). The object's `lea 0x2(%ecx),%edx` at 0x54d8a is the only thing that says which of the two was written. `+ 3` is entered instead, and is caught.
